audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Singed levels 2 and 3 and Skill at level 6, disagreeing with the already-audited mirror and the packet chart.
audit.why: Mirror: level 1 even, levels 2-3 Nautilus (Dredge Line plus Staggering Blow out-trade before Mega Adhesive exists), levels 4-5 even, level 6 Nautilus on Depth Charge, first item onward Singed.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill, Nautilus, Nautilus, Skill, Nautilus, Singed, Singed with ratings to match.

audit.why: Spikes: levels 2-3 combo window, level 6 Depth Charge (120/100/80s), first item Rylai's/Liandry's, late Singed. Insanity Potion is a flat 100s, so at R rank 1 his ult outlasts yours and at rank 3 yours outlasts his.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling is repeatedly called his W ('his W fling', 'flings (W) your carries', 'mid-W-trail'). Fling is E, 125 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. W is Mega Adhesive, 1000 range, 13-17s. The Fling-into-Adhesive root is never mentioned, and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot text: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' and 'making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds'.
audit.corrected: Fling (E) is his flip on 8-10s; landing in Mega Adhesive roots you and the goo grounds. Insanity Potion (100s) makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which cuts the Grasp and Second Wind sustain you lane on.

edits.before: His flip. Q-peel it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Fling (E) is 125 range, down 8-10s. Walk in once it is spent.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. Q-peel it. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: Fling (E) is 125 range on 8-10s; flung into Mega Adhesive you are rooted.

edits.after: - Singed Fling: 8-10s at 125 range — flung into Mega Adhesive roots you. Track it before every engage. - Dredge Line: never spend it on chip. - Depth Charge: kill windows only.

edits.before: Your passive root plus Q-pull is the whole early game — at Level 1 you are roughly even since you have no all-in without W or E, but your first auto roots him and that makes auto-trades favorable. The danger is his W fling: if you Q-engage into him at melee range he can fling you backward and walk off on his poison trail, so engage with E slow already on him. By Level 3 your Q-pull-into-root plus W splash burn wins nearly every short trade he tries to start with poison.
edits.after: Your passive root plus Q-pull is the whole early game — at Level 1 you are roughly even since you have no all-in without W or E, but your first auto roots him and that makes auto-trades favorable. The danger is Fling (E), down 8-10s: at melee range he flips you backward, and landing in Mega Adhesive roots you, so engage with Riptide slow already on him. By Level 3 your Q-pull into root plus W splash burn wins nearly every short trade he starts with poison.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a wash — he scales his poison and move speed, you scale W shield and E, and neither of you can fully commit. Then Level 6 is your real window: Depth Charge is homing and undodgeable, so it is the ONE piece of CC that catches a Singed who is mid-W-trail and trying to glide away. Chain it — R knock-up into E slow into Q — and call your jungler, because that is the only time in this lane you genuinely lock him down. Bait his fling by faking the Q before you commit the ult.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a wash — he scales his poison and move speed, you scale Titan's Wrath and Riptide, and neither of you can fully commit. Then Level 6 is your real window: Depth Charge is homing and undodgeable, the ONE piece of CC that catches a Singed laying Poison Trail and trying to glide away. Chain it — R knock-up into E slow into Q — and call your jungler, because that is the only real lockdown you get. Bait Fling (E) by faking the Q before you commit the ult.

notes: Slot mix-up corrected throughout: Fling is E, Mega Adhesive is W. Left alone: the claim that Singed proxies behind your tower (wants.foe[0]) — behavioural, not in the kit, and not contradicted.
